description: Add a to-do to the signed-in member's Checklist in Heed, with an optional detail and due date. Use it when the member says 'remind me to', 'add to my checklist' or 'I need to file X by'. This writes to their real record: repeat the item and the date in words first. Returns the item with its id.

detail.description: More detail, if the member gave any.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, when the member wants it done by.

title.description: What needs doing, in a few words.

name: add_checklist_item
title: Add a checklist item
